review_candidates.title: Cloud Integration Engineer
review_candidates.location: Newcastle Upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom
review_candidates.description: We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities. People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent. In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships. We also give back to our communities through our Collectively program which incorporates matched-funding, paid volunteering time and charitable donations. Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business. About the Opportunity: Amentum is seeking a talented and motivated Cloud Integration Engineer to join our growing cyber security team. As a Cloud Integration Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development and support of Azure Integration Services, cloud infrastructure and automation solutions. Working within a collaborative engineering team, you will help deliver resilient, secure and scalable integration capabilities that underpin critical business services. This is an exciting opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies and play a key role in the evolution of our integration capabilities. Working closely with architecture, security, project delivery and operational teams, you will contribute to the delivery of innovative solutions that enhance operational resilience, support digital transformation and reduce organisational risk. Key Responsibilities: Azure Integration Services Design, deploy, configure and maintain Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, Azure Data Factory, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure Functions and Logic Apps. Establish and maintain messaging services using Azure Service Bus queues, topics and subscriptions. Implement and support integration patterns, including message routing, orchestration and event-driven architectures. Configure and monitor dead-letter queues and integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with Azure Monitor. Support API onboarding, configuration and lifecycle management within Azure API Management. Cloud Infrastructure & Security Design and deploy enterprise-grade Azure cloud infrastructure in accordance with organisational standards, security requirements and governance controls. Implement network segregation, resource segmentation and security controls to support secure integration architectures. Ensure all solutions comply with SSE cloud, cyber security and operational standards. Infrastructure as Code & Automation Develop, maintain and enhance Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform. Create reusable templates, modules and deployment patterns to support standardised infrastructure provisioning. Define Azure integration components and infrastructure through code-based deployment methods. DevOps & CI/CD Develop, maintain and support CI/CD pipelines to automate solution deployment, testing and release management activities. Integrate unit testing and integration testing into deployment pipelines. Support automation using GitHub Actions and other CI/CD tooling where appropriate. Data Integration & Transformation Design and implement data integration, migration and transformation solutions. Support the movement and transformation of data using Azure Data Factory and other Azure integration technologies. Develop and maintain standardised data models and transformation patterns. Operational Support Provide ongoing operational support for cloud and integration platforms. Support incident resolution, service improvements, change management activities and platform maintenance. Perform platform upgrades, patching and evergreen maintenance activities to ensure services remain secure and supportable. Stakeholder Engagement & Documentation Work collaboratively with integration, project delivery, operational support, architecture and business teams. Participate in design workshops, technical reviews and knowledge transfer activities. Produce and maintain technical documentation, support documentation and operational procedures. Contribute to low-level designs, implementation plans and solution architecture documentation where required. Here's What You'll Need: A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Designing and delivering cloud-based integration solutions. Azure networking and security services. GitHub Actions and automated deployment pipelines. Data migration, transformation and integration projects. Producing technical documentation and implementation plans. Azure API Management (APIM). Monitoring and supporting cloud services in a production environment. Scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. Working in a regulated or security-conscious environment. Collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our Culture: Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration. We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work. When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful. We partner with VERCIDA, for greater online accessibility please visit www.vercida.com to view and access our roles. As a Disability Confident employer, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for a vacancy. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact andrew.duckworth@global.amentum.com
